finding: Creature families are layered data: one base template per family (34 templates across two mods), an element overlay (one animation line, a resist pair, and a ranged power id swapped fire 173 to ice 172 with a 50 percent slow for 2 s), per-file tier stats, and behaviour knobs. 124 top-level enemy files; 121 INCLUDE a base; 3 do not. Named defects: ice template points at a water animation sheet, power id 132 means different things per namespace, and the resist pattern varies with no named rule. Verdict STRONG for the overlay rule. Data half read; engine half (flareteam-flare-engine) not read. Licence CC-BY-SA 3.0 art and data: shape only.
